purpose: Read-only audit of the proposed evaluation/verifier changes before execution. No paid model calls or application changes in this review.

baseline.judge_calibration: results/judge-calibration.json contains an actual accepted response and a labeled synthetic fabricated guarantee; observed judgments match both labels.

statistical_check.scope: Illustrative binomial calculations only. The cases are a small purposive set; comparisons are paired, repeated trials and paraphrases are clustered. These values do not establish population reliability or significance of a difference.

integration_findings.finding: Verification-off arm is confounded by current integrity scorer
integration_findings.evidence: src/coreweaving/evaluate.py integrity includes output.verification.passed in all(checks.values())
integration_findings.required_change: Report factual answer quality separately from required deployment verification; record off as not run, not passed.

integration_findings.finding: Repeated trials overwrite local case evidence
integration_findings.evidence: QualityJudge.score writes RUN_DIRECTORY/cases/<case_id>.json; Evaluation.trials repeats dataset rows
integration_findings.required_change: Unique run/arm/case/trial or prediction-call IDs, trial counts, partial-run accounting and preserved initial/final drafts.

integration_findings.finding: Current verifier sees cited passages only
integration_findings.evidence: src/coreweaving/agent.py Agent.verify payload evidence is indexed by cited_ids(candidate.answer)
integration_findings.required_change: Separate claim support in cited evidence from coverage of user obligations against all relevant read evidence, including needed prior-turn passages.

integration_findings.finding: Proposed edits share interfaces across tracks
integration_findings.evidence: Verification schema consumed by app.py; evaluate.py constructs Settings and calls Agent.run; trial and mode fields affect traces and fixtures
integration_findings.required_change: Freeze schema/config/trial identity contracts before parallel implementation.

cost_scenarios.scope: Arithmetic scenarios, not forecasts. Multi-turn cases, added coverage, judge, retries, monitoring and regression runs need separate accounting. Caching savings have not been measured.

recommendation: Calibrate and freeze the evaluation instrument; measure caching without changing effort; add coverage while retaining material support gates; run a small paired pilot before deciding whether the full 216-case-trial study is justified. Keep the existing UI/library and planning artifacts.
